description: This file implements a WebRTC streamer component for the Android Open Source Project, handling peer connections, media tracks, and signaling communication with a server, including client management and media source setup.

classes.name: Streamer::Impl
classes.description: Implementation class for the WebRTC streamer, managing peer connections, signaling, client handlers, and media sources.

classes.name: AudioDeviceModuleWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class for managing the audio device module within the streamer.

methods.name: CreateClientHandler
methods.description: Creates a new client handler for a given client ID, setting up media tracks and observer callbacks.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Initiates registration with the signaling server, establishing WebSocket connection.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Constructs a WebRTC peer connection with specified ICE servers and observer.

methods.name: SendMessageToClient
methods.description: Sends a JSON message to a specific client via signaling.

methods.name: DestroyClientHandler
methods.description: Removes and cleans up a client handler for a given client ID.

methods.name: SetupCameraForClient
methods.description: Associates the camera stream with a specific client handler.

methods.name: OnOpen
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connection open event, sending registration info.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Handles WebSocket disconnection, attempting to reconnect.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles WebSocket errors, with retry logic.

methods.name: OnReceive
methods.description: Processes incoming signaling messages from the server.

methods.name: HandleConfigMessage
methods.description: Processes configuration messages, updating ICE servers.

methods.name: HandleClientMessage
methods.description: Processes messages from clients, creating handlers as needed.
